grades.overall_note: The agent handled the case well: it recognised the Breathing Space, sent compliant messages, informed the landlord and escalated the plan decision. Its weaknesses are that it could not cancel the scheduled actions, did not flag vulnerability, and gave only a generic pointer to the adviser.
